author: dramos3212
quote: game is genuinely horrible for the 13 years and 80-100 dollars u spend, first 4 hours are spent doing house repairs and chores, game is also comparable to cyberpunk launch lag and glitches. this game has a poorly planned out story compared to gta5, this game is also hooked the realism concept by making u have to do estensive work to stay fit and energized in mornings by working out and drink coffee, this game when truly compared to its predecessors losses its meaning to the name GTA, only thing keeping this game alive is the hype and the cool npc interactions other than that this game is horrendous flop, if it weren't a gta game and had to live up to the hype and time put into this game maybe it would be a better game but obviously its not and its shame people like myself waited years for this game and got this. only saving grace for this game might be gta online and even then u have to be skeptical, overall definitely not a game worth waiting 13 years and spending 80-100 dollars for this overrated slop
